say:3:1421121001:1.text: Wow, this mushroom soup is amazing! I love the refreshing flavor!
say:3:1421121001:1.source_cn: 哇，这个蘑菇鱼汤，好香好鲜，而且很清爽！

say:4:1421121002:1.text: It was our favorite dish when we were little. What we're having now is the more luxurious version.
say:4:1421121002:1.source_cn: 哈哈，这可是我们小时候最喜欢吃的东西，那会儿我们都是小...

say:5:1421121003:1.text: Back then, we'd put just a few fuzzy mushrooms into the soup since they can be poisonous.
say:5:1421121003:1.source_cn: 比如蘑菇鱼汤，因为茸茸伞菇容易有毒，我们不敢放很多，只...

say:6:1421121004:1.text: Did you and Captain Indris gather food in the wild often when you were kids?
say:6:1421121004:1.source_cn: 所以，芬洛先生，你和因度厄大人小时候也要经常到野外去和...

say:7:1421121005:1.text: We did. There were other orphans with us, but we were the ones leading the group. To be honest, I was just riding on Indris' coattails.
say:7:1421121005:1.source_cn: 没错，不止我们俩，当时有不少孤儿，只不过带头的是我们两...

say:8:1421121006:1.text: That guy's been sharp and strong since little. He always came back with a good haul, and he even picked up hunting in a short time!
say:8:1421121006:1.source_cn: 那家伙从小就很机敏，身手也好，不仅每次都能满载而归，很...

say:9:1421121007:1.text: So, Indris basically learned archery and built up his endurance in the wilderness... That's pretty impressive.
say:9:1421121007:1.source_cn: 原来他的弓箭和体能是在野外从小磨练出来的啊……真是了不起。

say:10:1421121008:1.text: Well, the rest of us didn't sit around either. Everyone would bring all the food to my place, and I'd prepare a meal for them.
say:10:1421121008:1.source_cn: 当然啦，我们也不会闲着，大家弄到食物以后都会汇集到我这...

say:11:1421121009:1.text: I'm a pretty good cook! We didn't always have food on the table, so I had to make do with whatever we had.
say:11:1421121009:1.source_cn: 我的手艺可不一般！毕竟我们那会儿经常饥一顿饱一顿，能用...

say:12:1421121010:1.text: Any other interesting stories from Captain Indris' childhood, Venlo?
say:12:1421121010:1.source_cn: 那，芬洛先生，因度厄大人他小时候还有什么出名的事迹吗？

say:13:1421121011:1.text: Hmm... Oh yeah, there was a time he rescued two of our companions from a Sinned One! He lured the beast out into the wild and returned a couple of days later!
say:13:1421121011:1.source_cn: 我想想，他曾经很英勇地在孽化者嘴下救出两个小伙伴，还把...

say:14:1421121012:1.text: Sounds similar to what you went through this time.
say:14:1421121012:1.source_cn: 咦，这不是和您这次的经历一样吗？

say:15:1421121013:1.text: It was way more dangerous back then, my beautiful lady! We were just kids, you know?
say:15:1421121013:1.source_cn: 不不不，漂亮的小姐，那都是多少年前了。而且那可是孽化者...

say:16:1421121014:1.text: Indris was battered when he came back. Guess it was pretty much his limit. If the guards hadn't stepped in, he might not have made it back.
say:16:1421121014:1.source_cn: 他回来的时候可是遍体鳞伤，他当时已经被逼到极限了。要不...

say:17:1421121015:1.text: Fortunately, he wasn't hurt by the Sinned One. He was just weak from malnourishment. We all cried and hugged him, but he ended up comforting us instead...
say:17:1421121015:1.source_cn: 万幸的是，他没被孽化者伤到。只是好几天没吃没喝，大家都...

say:18:1421121016:1.text: Thanks to his experience, I've learned how to handle all sorts of monsters and pulled off several narrow escapes myself...
say:18:1421121016:1.source_cn: 都是多亏了他的经验，我也才能在各种怪物的口中好几次死里...

narration:19:1421121017:1.text: Everyone enjoys the simple but delicious meal, laughing between bites as Venlo rambles on about his childhood adventures with Indris. His stories paint vivid pictures of days long past...
